title: Routine Police Call Turns into Terrifying Disaster
description:
► Beneath The Badge:
https://www.youtube.com/@Beneath_The_Badge 

On December 19, 2023, deputies were called to a disturbance in Sheboygan Falls, WI. A man had become upset after receiving legal papers from his significant other and started destroying property. When deputies arrived, he warned them to stay back before igniting a piece of paper and dropping it in gasoline.
